defs.def: the amount of money that you have to pay for sth 价格；价钱；物价

ex.s: pricing policy                     D. service team
ex.t: 巴吉的脖子上戴着一个污染监测器，因此它可以在地面附近采集数据。

ex.s: It's good for… There's… off the total price.
ex.t: 它有利于…… 总价有……的优惠。

ex.s: As digital technology comes down in price, and becomes easier to operate, it could help to transform old age for millions of people.
ex.t: 随着数字技术价格下降、操作变得越来越容易，它可以帮助改变数百万人的晚年生活。

ex.s: Hunters willingly pay the stamp price to ensure the survival of our natural resources.
ex.t: 猎人乐意支付鸭票的价格，以确保我们的自然资源得以存续。

ex.s: The price is too high.
ex.t: 这位女士会因为价格合理而买下这所房子。

ex.s: Price: Available upon request
ex.t: 价格：请咨询

ex.s: The purchase price could also be a signal that an established company is buying a new-born threat.
ex.t: 收购价格也可能是一个信号，表明一家老牌公司在收购一个新生威胁。

ex.s: Before _____64_____ (head) home, they fill their shopping bags with fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, at prices significantly _____65_____ (cheap) than those found in supermarkets.
ex.t: 在_____ 64 _____ （头部）回家之前，他们在购物袋中装满来自当地农民的新鲜水果和蔬菜，价格比超市中的价格便宜_____ 65 _____ （便宜）。

ex.s: As our ___47___ day drew near, I settled on a new price ($0) and reposted it.
ex.t: 随着我们的___47___之日临近，我定了个新价格（0美元）重新发布了。

ex.s: But driverless car ownership could increase as the prices drop and more people become comfortable with the technology.
ex.t: 但随着价格下降，越来越多的人对技术感到适应，无人驾驶汽车保有量可能会增加。

defs.def: the unpleasant things that you must do or experience in order to achieve sth or as a result of achieving sth 代价

ex.s: Pay special attention to “the price of success”, “stay with problems longer” and “a mere reed shaken in the wind”.
ex.t: 特别注意＂成功的代价＂、＂在问题上坚持更久＂和＂一根在风中摇曳的芦苇＂。

ex.s: I know the price of success: dedication, hard work and an unremitting devotion to the things you want to see happen.
ex.t: 我知道成功的代价：奉献、努力以及对你希望实现之事的不懈追求。

ex.s: “Sleep is the price we pay for learning,” says Giulio Tononi, who developed the idea.
ex.t: "睡眠是我们为学习付出的代价，"提出这一理念的朱利奥·托诺尼说。

ex.s: The price of fashion — economically and environmentally — has led to the rise of ___56___ new way of dressing, and it’s beginning to take off in Australia, too.
ex.t: 时尚的代价——无论是经济上还是环境上——催生了一种____56____新的穿衣方式，而且它也开始在澳大利亚流行起来。

defs.def: the numbers that tell you how much money you will receive if the horse that you bet on wins the race 赛马

ex.s: The woman will buy the house because the price is reasonable.
ex.t: 这位女士非常喜欢这所房子，她会买下它。

defs.def: costing a lot of money 以高价；花大钱

ex.s: Far from charging consumers high prices, many of these services are free (users pay, in effect, by handing over yet more data).
ex.t: 远非向消费者收取高价，许多这类服务都是免费的（用户实际上是通过交出更多数据来付费的）。

ex.s: It’s sold at a discount price.
ex.t: 它以折扣价出售。

defs.def: （认为得不偿失）… 不值得， … 有什么用？

ex.s: Richard @richard77 9 Nov Replying to @amyheart Indeed the exhibition is worth visiting, despite the over-priced tickets.
ex.t: 理查德 @richard77 11 月 9 日 回复 @amyheart 确实，尽管票价过高，这个展览还是值得一看的。

defs.def: （认为可能性不大）… 可能吗， … 不可能吧
to fix the price of sth at a particular level 给 … 定价；为 … 作价

ex.s: With gas prices rising and airport security lines snaking longer than ever, why not book your next domestic vacation on a train?
ex.t: 随着油价上涨和机场安检队伍排得前所未有的长，为什么不预订下一次国内旅行的火车票呢？

ex.s: We choose this hotel because the price for a night here is down to $20, half of _________ it used to charge.
ex.t: 我们选这家酒店是因为这里一晚的价格降到了20美元，是它过去收费的一半。

ex.s: However, if you’re shopping for one, buying extra   56   (benefit) from price reductions doesn’t make sense.
ex.t: 然而，如果你是为一个人购物，因降价而多买____56____（受益）并不划算。

ex.s: Now I was paying the price — to write a five-page essay on “Why I Should Not Talk in Class”.
ex.t: 现在我付出了代价——要写一篇五页的文章，题目是"我为什么不该在课堂上讲话"。

ex.s: The stamp price has gone down.
ex.t: 候鸟飞走了。

ex.s: The price is reasonable.
ex.t: 出价不公平。

ex.s: The price is low.
ex.t: 这所房子真的很好，因为浴室与卧室相连。

ex.s: Of course, shops are not charities — they price goods in the way   58 will make them the most money.
ex.t: 当然，商店不是慈善机构——它们以58能赚最多钱的方式为商品定价。

defs.def: to write or stick tickets on goods to show how much they cost （在商品上）标价，贴价格标签

ex.s: (Included in tickets price)
ex.t: (包括票价)

ex.s: They raised the prices of their products.
ex.t: 它们削减了产量。

defs.def: to compare the prices of different types of the same thing 比较 … 的价格

ex.s: A couple of messages came in, one wanting additional ___46___, another asking for a price cut.
ex.t: 来了几条消息，一个想要更多___46___，另一个要求降价。

ex.s: their new appearance and lower pricesB. the push of the local organizations
ex.t: 它们焕然一新的外观和更低的价格 B. 地方组织的推动

ex.s: Compare their prices.
ex.t: 比较它们的价格。

ex.s: favour bigger firmsD. charge higher prices
ex.t: 偏爱大公司D. 收取更高的价格
